title: Indian Railways Approves New Daily Express Service Between Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus and Sawantwadi Road
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Railways

Indian Railways Approves New Daily Express Service Between Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus and Sawantwadi Road

510-km Daily Express to Improve Rail Connectivity Across Maharashtra, Providing Direct Access to Mumbai, Thane, Panvel, Ratnagiri, Sindhudurg and Other Key Stations Along the Konkan Coast
New Service to Benefit Tourism, Business, Education and Regional Mobility While Strengthening Rail Connectivity Across the Konkan Region

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
01 AUG 2026 1:29PM by PIB Delhi

In a major boost to passenger connectivity in Maharashtra and the Konkan region, Indian Railways has approved the introduction of a new daily Express train service between Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus (Mumbai) and Sawantwadi Road. The new service will provide direct, convenient and reliable rail connectivity across the 510-km route, benefiting thousands of passengers travelling for tourism, education, employment, business and social purposes.

The proposed train will operate daily as Train No. 15087 Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus-Sawantwadi Road Express and Train No. 15088 Sawantwadi Road-Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj Terminus Express.

Extensive Connectivity Across the Konkan Region

The new daily Express service will provide commercial stoppages at:

Dadar

Thane

Panvel

Pen

Roha

Mangaon

Veer

Khed

Chiplun

Savarda

Aravali Road

Sangameshwar Road

Ratnagiri

Adavali

Valivade

Rajapur Road

Vaibhavwadi Road

Nandgaon Road

Kankavli

Sindhudurg

Kudal

Sawantwadi Road

The train will offer seamless connectivity between Mumbai Metropolitan Region and important towns & districts, significantly improving accessibility to the Konkan coast.

Boost to Tourism, Economy and Passenger Convenience

The introduction of this new service will strengthen rail connectivity between Mumbai and southern Konkan, making travel easier for tourists visiting the region's beaches, forts, temples and eco-tourism destinations. The service will also benefit daily commuters, students, traders, small businesses and residents by providing an additional direct rail option between Mumbai and the Konkan region.

The new train is expected to support regional economic development, facilitate smoother passenger movement and improve overall travel convenience while complementing the growing demand for rail transport on the Konkan route.

The new daily Express service reflects Indian Railways' continued commitment to expanding passenger connectivity, improving travel convenience and supporting balanced regional development through a stronger and more accessible railway network.

 *****

Mahesh Kumar/ Dr. Nayan Solanki/ Ritu Raj/ Vanshita Jaiswal
